description.describe_ch: 課程將概述和辨別影響著世界各地的市場行銷組合應用程序的主要勢力。內容側重於學生在今後的工作和學術環境裡可能使用的市場行銷概念和詞彙。此外，在課程上也會檢討個案和論文以提供學生對於真實世界的問題和環境有更深的了解。學生上完這門課程後應該具備分析問題和任務的能力，並能在以全球為導向的行銷策略形成與執行上給予富有洞察力、有彈性和符合地方文化的建議。
description.describe_eh: This course outlines and identifies the major forces that influence the application of the marketing mix around the world. Content focuses on concepts and vocabulary used in marketing situations students may encounter in future work and academic settings. In addition, cases and articles may be reviewed to supply a deeper understanding of real world issues and contexts. Students should emerge from this course with the ability to analyze issues and assignments and provide insightful, flexible, and culturally appropriate suggestions for the formation and implementation of globally-oriented marketing strategies. Course reading materials are delivered in an interactive online format that includes quizzes. In class work consists of groups assigments and presentations.

targets.describe_ch: 開發出具有戰略性和全球性的行銷管理看法。
targets.describe_en: Develop strategic and global marketing management perspective.

targets.describe_ch: 將知識和概念運用在現實世界中的行銷環境。
targets.describe_en: Apply knowledge and concepts to real world marketing contexts.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂上的行為始終要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂規則，習慣班級文化。
一、課堂禮儀
1.	多元化和包容性
課程活動都在同學間的友好參與和互動氛圍中進行，彼此間應尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經歷、背景和觀點，如國內外各學制、多元入學及學習文化、種族文化、社經背景、性別等。
2.	課堂行為
(1)	學生應準時出席上課；如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。
(2)	上課時請勿講話、閱讀其他刊物、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除積極參與分組討論外，應減少與旁邊同學對話。
(3)	當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。
二、課程交流及網路禮儀
1.	iLearn仍然是教室，必須遵守適當的課堂行為，尊重同學和老師。
2.	您應留出時間，積極參與iLearn線上學習活動，並完成所有交付之學習任務，來完成課程活動。
3.	每次線上討論區，不要強勢主導任何討論，要給其他同學參加討論的機會，以提高每個人的學習體驗。
(1)	每個人均要保持開放的態度，尊重少數意見，甚至您也可以表達不同的意見。
(2)	適當地提出您的想法，並避免使用粗俗或令人反感的語言。
(3)	依主題寫作，重點和簡短表達。
(4)	在發表評論之前先閱讀所有發表文章或評論，再撰寫，以防止重複評論或提出已經回答的問題。
(5)	撰寫評論文字，應審閱、再審閱後發送。
(6)	網路溝通的語言。請避免過度使用表情符號。
(7)	避免使用地方語或俚語，有可能會導致誤解。
(8)	與其他學生分享提示，勿取笑某人的閱讀聽寫能力。
(9)	考慮他人的隱私。在給出同學的電子郵件地址或其他信息之前，請先徵得許可。
(10)	不能發表不當訊息；不要將病毒警告、連鎖信、笑話等轉發給同學或教師。
三、學生責任
1.	每位學生於每學期開學前，到MyFCU個人資料表，確認自己在逢甲大學所留的個人基本資料，包含手機電話、通訊住址等聯絡資訊，以利授課教師、教學助理、或開課單位職員能與您聯繫。
(1)	確認您的逢甲大學o365電子郵件和NID是開通的，o365作為師生教學與學習溝通之共通工具。
(2)	與教師和班上的同學進行電子郵件、公告欄等交流時，要寫清楚資訊，保持禮貌。
(3)	您的電子郵件要署名，老師不會回覆“匿名”信件。
2.	您要詳讀及了解本課程的教學大綱要求，即時更新最新資訊，做好學習時間的管理。
3.	隨時檢查您的逢甲大學電子郵件和登錄iLearn 清楚本課程所發布之訊息。
4.	您應依老師的授課內容與教學方式，對本科目填寫期中、期末之課程教學回饋意見。您的參與及回饋，將幫助老師改善上課技巧、課程教學內容及學習活動的安排。期中形成性教學評估表在第4~8週填寫；期末學生意見調查、期末課程目標學習達成情形在學期最後一個月填寫。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
In-Class Conduct and Responsibilities

Classroom behavior should always be punctual, professional, well-prepared, and courteous. Mutual dignity and respect between students and instructors are essential for effective learning. To maintain a positive and productive learning environment, everyone is expected to follow classroom rules and adapt to class culture.

I. Classroom Etiquette
Diversity and Inclusion
All course activities take place in an atmosphere of friendly participation and interaction among students. Everyone should respect and appreciate each classmate’s unique experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, including those related to different education systems (domestic and international), admission pathways, learning cultures, race, socioeconomic status, gender, and more.

Classroom Behavior

(1) Students must attend class on time. If you cannot attend class punctually, please do not enroll in the course.

(2) During class, do not talk, read unrelated materials, sleep, or engage in tasks not related to the course. Apart from active participation in group discussions, minimize conversation with nearby classmates.

(3) When classmates are giving presentations or asking questions, you are expected to listen attentively.

II. Course Communication and Online Etiquette
iLearn is an extension of the classroom, and appropriate behavior is still required. Respect your classmates and instructors at all times.

You should dedicate time to actively participate in iLearn online activities and complete all assigned tasks.

Do not dominate any discussion thread. Allow all students the opportunity to contribute to improve the learning experience for everyone.

(1) Maintain an open mindset. Respect minority opinions and feel free to express differing views.

(2) Share your thoughts appropriately and avoid using offensive or vulgar language.

(3) Stay on topic and express your points clearly and concisely.

(4) Read all existing posts or comments before submitting your own to avoid repetition or asking questions that have already been answered.

(5) Review and revise your comments before posting them.

(6) Use language appropriately in online communication. Avoid excessive emojis.

(7) Avoid using regional dialects or slang that may cause misunderstandings.

(8) Share helpful tips, but never mock someone's reading or spelling skills.

(9) Respect others' privacy. Do not share classmates' email addresses or other personal information without their consent.

(10) Do not post inappropriate messages or forward virus alerts, chain letters, jokes, etc., to classmates or instructors.

III. Student Responsibilities
Before the start of each semester, students must check and update their personal information (e.g., mobile number, mailing address) via the MyFCU system to ensure instructors, TAs, or administrative staff can contact them when necessary.

(1) Ensure your Feng Chia University O365 email and NID are activated, as these are the primary tools for teaching and learning communication.

(2) When communicating via email or announcements with instructors or classmates, be clear and courteous.

(3) Always sign your emails; instructors will not respond to anonymous messages.

Read and understand the course syllabus and keep up-to-date with the latest announcements. Manage your study time effectively.

Check your Feng Chia University email and iLearn regularly to stay informed about course-related announcements.

You are expected to complete both midterm and final course evaluations, based on the instructor’s teaching style and content. Your feedback helps instructors improve their teaching methods, course content, and learning activities.

Midterm formative teaching evaluations are conducted between weeks 4–8, and final student feedback along with course learning outcome assessments are collected during the last month of the semester.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1.    誠信是基本的態度與專業價值的宣言，是將學術理想轉化為行動的行為原則以及落實社會責任。
2.    學術誠信最重要的價值觀之一是思想自由流動與尊重他人智慧財產權之間的平衡。
  • 學生應重視及恪遵智慧財產權。不得在學術活動中給予、使用或接受未經授權的援助。使用圖書館館藏、有版權的教材讀本與影音資料。
  • 恪守誠信，積極出席和參與課堂的學習承諾。
  • 學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以負責和禮貌的態度行事。
3.    學生有責任做好自己的學習任務，並避免一切形式的學術不誠實行為。
  • 不作弊：紙筆測驗時，不得交談、窺竊他人試卷或故意便利鄰座竊窺，或有夾帶、抄襲或傳遞資料等情事經發現時，違者該次考試成績以零分計算。並視違者情節，或有替考情事，其舞弊之雙方，將依逢甲大學學生考試辦法、學生獎懲辦法之相關規定處理。
  • 不抄襲：提交原創作品，嚴禁任何形式的抄襲。
  • 不偽造：篡改成績或其他正式文件，如診所就醫證明。
  • 不篡改/不捏造：從實驗中蒐集數據過程，以人為方式創建數據或編造不存在的數據或資料來源，均被視為捏造或篡改
  • 不破壞：破壞他人的藝術品、實驗或設計成果被視為破壞行為。未能為團隊專題做出貢獻，也被視為學術破壞。
以上情況視違者情節，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法等相關規定提送處分
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
1. Integrity is a fundamental attitude and a declaration of professional values.
    It serves as a guiding principle for translating academic ideals into actions and fulfilling social responsibility.
  2. One of the most important values of academic integrity is the balance between the free flow of ideas and respect for intellectual property.
    Students should value and strictly adhere to intellectual property rights. Unauthorized assistance must not be given, used, or accepted in academic activities.
    This includes the proper use of library collections, copyrighted textbooks, and audiovisual materials.
    Uphold honesty, and actively commit to class attendance and participation.
    Students should respect everyone in the classroom and always act in a responsible and courteous manner.
  3. Students are responsible for completing their own academic tasks and avoiding all forms of academic dishonesty.
    • No cheating: During written exams, students must not engage in conversation, peek at others' test papers, allow others to peek, bring unauthorized materials, copy, or pass information. Any of these actions, once discovered, will result in a zero for the exam. In severe cases, such as impersonation, both parties involved will be dealt with according to Feng Chia University’s regulations on student examinations and disciplinary actions.
    • No plagiarism: Submit original work. Any form of plagiarism is strictly prohibited.
    • No forgery: Altering grades or official documents, such as medical certificates, is forbidden.
    • No falsification/fabrication: Creating or inventing data or sources in the process of data collection (e.g., for experiments) is considered fabrication or falsification.
    • No sabotage: Damaging others' artworks, experimental results, or design projects is considered sabotage. Failing to contribute to a team project is also seen as academic sabotage.
Depending on the severity of the violation, the above behaviors will be subject to disciplinary action in accordance with Feng Chia University’s student regulations.

integrity.course_pol_en:
In-Class Conduct and Responsibilities

Classroom behavior should always be punctual, professional, well-prepared, and courteous. Mutual dignity and respect between students and instructors are essential for effective learning. To maintain a positive and productive learning environment, everyone is expected to follow classroom rules and adapt to class culture.

I. Classroom Etiquette
Diversity and Inclusion
All course activities take place in an atmosphere of friendly participation and interaction among students. Everyone should respect and appreciate each classmate’s unique experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, including those related to different education systems (domestic and international), admission pathways, learning cultures, race, socioeconomic status, gender, and more.

Classroom Behavior

(1) Students must attend class on time. If you cannot attend class punctually, please do not enroll in the course.

(2) During class, do not talk, read unrelated materials, sleep, or engage in tasks not related to the course. Apart from active participation in group discussions, minimize conversation with nearby classmates.

(3) When classmates are giving presentations or asking questions, you are expected to listen attentively.

II. Course Communication and Online Etiquette
iLearn is an extension of the classroom, and appropriate behavior is still required. Respect your classmates and instructors at all times.

You should dedicate time to actively participate in iLearn online activities and complete all assigned tasks.

Do not dominate any discussion thread. Allow all students the opportunity to contribute to improve the learning experience for everyone.

(1) Maintain an open mindset. Respect minority opinions and feel free to express differing views.

(2) Share your thoughts appropriately and avoid using offensive or vulgar language.

(3) Stay on topic and express your points clearly and concisely.

(4) Read all existing posts or comments before submitting your own to avoid repetition or asking questions that have already been answered.

(5) Review and revise your comments before posting them.

(6) Use language appropriately in online communication. Avoid excessive emojis.

(7) Avoid using regional dialects or slang that may cause misunderstandings.

(8) Share helpful tips, but never mock someone's reading or spelling skills.

(9) Respect others' privacy. Do not share classmates' email addresses or other personal information without their consent.

(10) Do not post inappropriate messages or forward virus alerts, chain letters, jokes, etc., to classmates or instructors.

III. Student Responsibilities
Before the start of each semester, students must check and update their personal information (e.g., mobile number, mailing address) via the MyFCU system to ensure instructors, TAs, or administrative staff can contact them when necessary.

(1) Ensure your Feng Chia University O365 email and NID are activated, as these are the primary tools for teaching and learning communication.

(2) When communicating via email or announcements with instructors or classmates, be clear and courteous.

(3) Always sign your emails; instructors will not respond to anonymous messages.

Read and understand the course syllabus and keep up-to-date with the latest announcements. Manage your study time effectively.

Check your Feng Chia University email and iLearn regularly to stay informed about course-related announcements.

You are expected to complete both midterm and final course evaluations, based on the instructor’s teaching style and content. Your feedback helps instructors improve their teaching methods, course content, and learning activities.

Midterm formative teaching evaluations are conducted between weeks 4–8, and final student feedback along with course learning outcome assessments are collected during the last month of the semester.

integrity.ais_meno:
1.    誠信是基本的態度與專業價值的宣言，是將學術理想轉化為行動的行為原則以及落實社會責任。
2.    學術誠信最重要的價值觀之一是思想自由流動與尊重他人智慧財產權之間的平衡。
  • 學生應重視及恪遵智慧財產權。不得在學術活動中給予、使用或接受未經授權的援助。使用圖書館館藏、有版權的教材讀本與影音資料。
  • 恪守誠信，積極出席和參與課堂的學習承諾。
  • 學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以負責和禮貌的態度行事。
3.    學生有責任做好自己的學習任務，並避免一切形式的學術不誠實行為。
  • 不作弊：紙筆測驗時，不得交談、窺竊他人試卷或故意便利鄰座竊窺，或有夾帶、抄襲或傳遞資料等情事經發現時，違者該次考試成績以零分計算。並視違者情節，或有替考情事，其舞弊之雙方，將依逢甲大學學生考試辦法、學生獎懲辦法之相關規定處理。
  • 不抄襲：提交原創作品，嚴禁任何形式的抄襲。
  • 不偽造：篡改成績或其他正式文件，如診所就醫證明。
  • 不篡改/不捏造：從實驗中蒐集數據過程，以人為方式創建數據或編造不存在的數據或資料來源，均被視為捏造或篡改
  • 不破壞：破壞他人的藝術品、實驗或設計成果被視為破壞行為。未能為團隊專題做出貢獻，也被視為學術破壞。
以上情況視違者情節，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法等相關規定提送處分
integrity.ais_meno_en:
1. Integrity is a fundamental attitude and a declaration of professional values.
    It serves as a guiding principle for translating academic ideals into actions and fulfilling social responsibility.
  2. One of the most important values of academic integrity is the balance between the free flow of ideas and respect for intellectual property.
    Students should value and strictly adhere to intellectual property rights. Unauthorized assistance must not be given, used, or accepted in academic activities.
    This includes the proper use of library collections, copyrighted textbooks, and audiovisual materials.
    Uphold honesty, and actively commit to class attendance and participation.
    Students should respect everyone in the classroom and always act in a responsible and courteous manner.
  3. Students are responsible for completing their own academic tasks and avoiding all forms of academic dishonesty.
    • No cheating: During written exams, students must not engage in conversation, peek at others' test papers, allow others to peek, bring unauthorized materials, copy, or pass information. Any of these actions, once discovered, will result in a zero for the exam. In severe cases, such as impersonation, both parties involved will be dealt with according to Feng Chia University’s regulations on student examinations and disciplinary actions.
    • No plagiarism: Submit original work. Any form of plagiarism is strictly prohibited.
    • No forgery: Altering grades or official documents, such as medical certificates, is forbidden.
    • No falsification/fabrication: Creating or inventing data or sources in the process of data collection (e.g., for experiments) is considered fabrication or falsification.
    • No sabotage: Damaging others' artworks, experimental results, or design projects is considered sabotage. Failing to contribute to a team project is also seen as academic sabotage.
Depending on the severity of the violation, the above behaviors will be subject to disciplinary action in accordance with Feng Chia University’s student regulations.

(3)	當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。
二、課程交流及網路禮儀
1.	iLearn仍然是教室，必須遵守適當的課堂行為，尊重同學和老師。
2.	您應留出時間，積極參與iLearn線上學習活動，並完成所有交付之學習任務，來完成課程活動。
3.	每次線上討論區，不要強勢主導任何討論，要給其他同學參加討論的機會，以提高每個人的學習體驗。
(1)	每個人均要保持開放的態度，尊重少數意見，甚至您也可以表達不同的意見。
(2)	適當地提出您的想法，並避免使用粗俗或令人反感的語言。
(3)	依主題寫作，重點和簡短表達。
(4)	在發表評論之前先閱讀所有發表文章或評論，再撰寫，以防止重複評論或提出已經回答的問題。
(5)	撰寫評論文字，應審閱、再審閱後發送。
(6)	網路溝通的語言。請避免過度使用表情符號。
(7)	避免使用地方語或俚語，有可能會導致誤解。
(8)	與其他學生分享提示，勿取笑某人的閱讀聽寫能力。
(9)	考慮他人的隱私。在給出同學的電子郵件地址或其他信息之前，請先徵得許可。
(10)	不能發表不當訊息；不要將病毒警告、連鎖信、笑話等轉發給同學或教師。
三、學生責任
1.	每位學生於每學期開學前，到MyFCU個人資料表，確認自己在逢甲大學所留的個人基本資料，包含手機電話、通訊住址等聯絡資訊，以利授課教師、教學助理、或開課單位職員能與您聯繫。
(1)	確認您的逢甲大學o365電子郵件和NID是開通的，o365作為師生教學與學習溝通之共通工具。
(2)	與教師和班上的同學進行電子郵件、公告欄等交流時，要寫清楚資訊，保持禮貌。
(3)	您的電子郵件要署名，老師不會回覆“匿名”信件。
2.	您要詳讀及了解本課程的教學大綱要求，即時更新最新資訊，做好學習時間的管理。
3.	隨時檢查您的逢甲大學電子郵件和登錄iLearn 清楚本課程所發布之訊息。
4.	您應依老師的授課內容與教學方式，對本科目填寫期中、期末之課程教學回饋意見。您的參與及回饋，將幫助老師改善上課技巧、課程教學內容及學習活動的安排。期中形成性教學評估表在第4~8週填寫；期末學生意見調查、期末課程目標學習達成情形在學期最後一個月填寫。
policy.course_rem_en:
In-Class Conduct and Responsibilities

Classroom behavior should always be punctual, professional, well-prepared, and courteous. Mutual dignity and respect between students and instructors are essential for effective learning. To maintain a positive and productive learning environment, everyone is expected to follow classroom rules and adapt to class culture.

I. Classroom Etiquette
Diversity and Inclusion
All course activities take place in an atmosphere of friendly participation and interaction among students. Everyone should respect and appreciate each classmate’s unique experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, including those related to different education systems (domestic and international), admission pathways, learning cultures, race, socioeconomic status, gender, and more.

Classroom Behavior

(1) Students must attend class on time. If you cannot attend class punctually, please do not enroll in the course.

(2) During class, do not talk, read unrelated materials, sleep, or engage in tasks not related to the course. Apart from active participation in group discussions, minimize conversation with nearby classmates.

(3) When classmates are giving presentations or asking questions, you are expected to listen attentively.

II. Course Communication and Online Etiquette
iLearn is an extension of the classroom, and appropriate behavior is still required. Respect your classmates and instructors at all times.

You should dedicate time to actively participate in iLearn online activities and complete all assigned tasks.

Do not dominate any discussion thread. Allow all students the opportunity to contribute to improve the learning experience for everyone.

(1) Maintain an open mindset. Respect minority opinions and feel free to express differing views.

(2) Share your thoughts appropriately and avoid using offensive or vulgar language.

(3) Stay on topic and express your points clearly and concisely.

(4) Read all existing posts or comments before submitting your own to avoid repetition or asking questions that have already been answered.

(5) Review and revise your comments before posting them.

(6) Use language appropriately in online communication. Avoid excessive emojis.

(7) Avoid using regional dialects or slang that may cause misunderstandings.

(8) Share helpful tips, but never mock someone's reading or spelling skills.

(9) Respect others' privacy. Do not share classmates' email addresses or other personal information without their consent.

(10) Do not post inappropriate messages or forward virus alerts, chain letters, jokes, etc., to classmates or instructors.

III. Student Responsibilities
Before the start of each semester, students must check and update their personal information (e.g., mobile number, mailing address) via the MyFCU system to ensure instructors, TAs, or administrative staff can contact them when necessary.

(1) Ensure your Feng Chia University O365 email and NID are activated, as these are the primary tools for teaching and learning communication.

(2) When communicating via email or announcements with instructors or classmates, be clear and courteous.

(3) Always sign your emails; instructors will not respond to anonymous messages.

Read and understand the course syllabus and keep up-to-date with the latest announcements. Manage your study time effectively.

Check your Feng Chia University email and iLearn regularly to stay informed about course-related announcements.

You are expected to complete both midterm and final course evaluations, based on the instructor’s teaching style and content. Your feedback helps instructors improve their teaching methods, course content, and learning activities.

Midterm formative teaching evaluations are conducted between weeks 4–8, and final student feedback along with course learning outcome assessments are collected during the last month of the semester.
policy.ais_meno:
1.    誠信是基本的態度與專業價值的宣言，是將學術理想轉化為行動的行為原則以及落實社會責任。
2.    學術誠信最重要的價值觀之一是思想自由流動與尊重他人智慧財產權之間的平衡。
  • 學生應重視及恪遵智慧財產權。不得在學術活動中給予、使用或接受未經授權的援助。使用圖書館館藏、有版權的教材讀本與影音資料。
  • 恪守誠信，積極出席和參與課堂的學習承諾。
  • 學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以負責和禮貌的態度行事。
3.    學生有責任做好自己的學習任務，並避免一切形式的學術不誠實行為。
  • 不作弊：紙筆測驗時，不得交談、窺竊他人試卷或故意便利鄰座竊窺，或有夾帶、抄襲或傳遞資料等情事經發現時，違者該次考試成績以零分計算。並視違者情節，或有替考情事，其舞弊之雙方，將依逢甲大學學生考試辦法、學生獎懲辦法之相關規定處理。
  • 不抄襲：提交原創作品，嚴禁任何形式的抄襲。
  • 不偽造：篡改成績或其他正式文件，如診所就醫證明。
  • 不篡改/不捏造：從實驗中蒐集數據過程，以人為方式創建數據或編造不存在的數據或資料來源，均被視為捏造或篡改
  • 不破壞：破壞他人的藝術品、實驗或設計成果被視為破壞行為。未能為團隊專題做出貢獻，也被視為學術破壞。
以上情況視違者情節，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法等相關規定提送處分
policy.ais_meno_en:
1. Integrity is a fundamental attitude and a declaration of professional values.
    It serves as a guiding principle for translating academic ideals into actions and fulfilling social responsibility.
  2. One of the most important values of academic integrity is the balance between the free flow of ideas and respect for intellectual property.
    Students should value and strictly adhere to intellectual property rights. Unauthorized assistance must not be given, used, or accepted in academic activities.
    This includes the proper use of library collections, copyrighted textbooks, and audiovisual materials.
    Uphold honesty, and actively commit to class attendance and participation.
    Students should respect everyone in the classroom and always act in a responsible and courteous manner.
  3. Students are responsible for completing their own academic tasks and avoiding all forms of academic dishonesty.
    • No cheating: During written exams, students must not engage in conversation, peek at others' test papers, allow others to peek, bring unauthorized materials, copy, or pass information. Any of these actions, once discovered, will result in a zero for the exam. In severe cases, such as impersonation, both parties involved will be dealt with according to Feng Chia University’s regulations on student examinations and disciplinary actions.
    • No plagiarism: Submit original work. Any form of plagiarism is strictly prohibited.
    • No forgery: Altering grades or official documents, such as medical certificates, is forbidden.
    • No falsification/fabrication: Creating or inventing data or sources in the process of data collection (e.g., for experiments) is considered fabrication or falsification.
    • No sabotage: Damaging others' artworks, experimental results, or design projects is considered sabotage. Failing to contribute to a team project is also seen as academic sabotage.
Depending on the severity of the violation, the above behaviors will be subject to disciplinary action in accordance with Feng Chia University’s student regulations.
